uncited: Compute the squared L2 norm for each vector by summing the squares of its components.
Take the square root of the sum to obtain the L2 norm.
Divide each component of the original vectors by their respective L2 norm plus a stability constant $\epsilon$ to obtain normalized vectors on the unit hypersphere.
Compute the dot product of the two normalized vectors.
Return the dot product as the similarity score.
Typical values are not given in the sources.
